text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru and I are on our way
back to
the academy after a day out,
when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I trip on something and fall over.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Whoa! Are you okay, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nooooo! Your shoelaces have snapped!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This is just as bad as the straps on your
geta sandals breaking! My unlucky
streak is back to
wreak havoc once
more!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, didn't something like this happen
before?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Anyways, this is no laughing matter! We
must
perform a warding ritual right away
to keep you
safe!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's put this luck-boosting
magic I saw
on the internet to the test!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
This is called the hand-holding spell!
Your luck
improves when you hold
someone's hand!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now, take hold of my hand!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
There is no time for hesitation! Don't you
see that
havoc is upon us?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Come on, hurry up!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Let the luck-boosting commence! Ho!
choice_data_list: Play it off with a high five

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
See, don't you feel how toasty your
hands are
with all the lucky power
seeping in?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ahh... It feels a lot warmer than when I
perform
this spell with other people.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that you're brimming with
good luck?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hehe, what an interesting discovery!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After that, Matikanefukukitaru becomes
a bit obsessed with the hand-holding
spell, trying it
with me whenever her
luck is bad.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Oh uh... Woo?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I don't really understand why, but I feel
so
uplifted!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Do high fives possess some sort of hidden
power?! Could it be that this is
far more powerful
than the hand-holding
spell?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's keep going! Yeah, high
five!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Haha, this is so much fun! Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We continue to high-five in front of the
entrance for about half an hour.
Strangely enough, it
makes for a good
bit of stress relief.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What?! Are you sure you want to pass on
this?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Could this be your way of protecting
me?! You're
too kind...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You're worried the havoc that plagues
you will be
passed on to me instead,
right?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
But there's no need to worry! Trainers
and the Umamusume they mentor are
bound by destiny,
so what's yours is
already mine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
However, I appreciate your
consideration. In
return, I shall try my
hand at another type of
spell!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Nrggh... No bad luck will befall my
trainer!
Depart, depart at once!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She casts several protective spells over
me as we make our way home, declaring
that it would be
disastrous if anything
happened to me.
